explication: WeKnora is an enterprise knowledge platform combining document ingestion, semantic retrieval, RAG chat, ReAct agents, sandboxes, memory, and wiki curation. The principal workflow is: a user submits a question in the web chat; the chat API starts an agent session; the agent consults retrieval and tools, calls an LLM, and streams reasoning, citations, and results back to the UI. Document parsing, storage, multi-workspace controls, and optional integrations support that workflow. Several backend routes and subsystems are represented from documented capabilities and tree paths; their detailed call wiring was not sampled.
